ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher (NS-7); no account flag — driver's arrival/position at tap satisfies NS-1(i)(ii).
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen: the two chat messages [F9][F10] are routine pickup/cancellation notices, the complaint is purely a fee dispute, and no driver statement contains threats, harassment, sexual remarks or dangerous-driving allegations. safety_concern = none.

Route: this is a no-show / cancellation-fee dispute (cancelled_by = driver, driver asserting rider no-show) [F4], so NS-0 directs it to NS-1 / NS-2.

NS-1 elements:
(i) Arrival indicated — yes: the driver tapped "I'm Here" at 13:02:35 [F6], and the platform separately recorded arrival at 13:01:00 [F5]; the record shows a driver tap, so no misattribution of an automatic arrival is needed.
(ii) Position at the tap — yes: 39 m from the pickup at that moment [F6], within the data-layer 200 m radius; closest approach 38 m [F1].
(iii) Continuous wait > 3 minutes after the tap — NO. The driver cancelled at 13:05:30, i.e. 2 min 55 s after the 13:02:35 tap [F6]; the timeline confirms the fee was charged only 4 min 30 s after the platform's 13:01:00 arrival record, and cancellation came 7 min 30 s after acceptance [F5][F4]. The driver's own chat says only "More than 3 min already" [F10] and his written statement claims "more than 3 minutes" [F12], but the system records (timeline/GPS) override statements, and they fix the post-tap wait at 2:55 — short of the required ≥ 3:01.

Because (iii) fails, NS-2 applies: the $6.61 cancellation fee must be refunded in full. Note the driver did press "I'm Here" while inside the pickup radius [F6], so the NS-2 account-flag limb (tap while more than 200 m away) is not triggered and no flag_account is warranted. Time limit is met (dispute within 30 days) and any refund is a Ryde voucher, not cash (NS-7).

Amount: the fee on record is $6.61 [F7][F4]; surge is 1.0× [F8] so no adjustment; refund_full = $6.61. Traffic facts [F13][F14] are irrelevant to a cancellation-fee dispute, and rider/driver profile facts [F16][F17] do not decide the case and attract no action under RD-6 (no route deviation refund here).

evidence_status: sufficient — GPS, arrival tap, timeline and a fully timestamped chat record [F11] settle every element; no evidence gap.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's statement that he waited more than 3 minutes after pressing 'I'm Here' is contradicted by the system records: tap at 13:02:35 and cancellation at 13:05:30 give 2 min 55 s [F6], and the timeline shows 4 min 30 s since the platform arrival record [F5]. System records override statements.
